text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired (PD#4021): high GPU vmem pressure on pool=gpupool-e2 region=us-west2 node=vm-53. Error sample: "NVML: Out Of Memory (13)". Auto-throttle engaged. Requesting on-call

olivia: acked. I'm on it, pulling traces.

sam: seeing increased 503s from hosted-infer-usw2 for small batch gen. Correlates with vm-53 CPU/GPU flapping.

matt: @olivia FYI PD routed to you as primary, I'll stand by to reroute traffic to the cpu-fallback pool.

jose: quick check — any active model loads on vm-53? kube shows restart_count=1 for inferd-12.

olivia: grabbing dmesg + nvml logs now. snippet: ```[ 1234.567890] nvidia: Xid (13) -- Out of memory```. Also seeing repeated cudaMemcpy failures in the runtime logs.

maya: adding runbook link: https://redwood.runbooks/gpu-oom. Steps 1-3 look relevant (evacuate, fallback, scale).

olivia: executed evacuate on vm-53, draining new allocations. Started controlled restart of inferd-12.

sam: started traffic switch for customer-tier=hosted to cpu-fallback in region=us-west2. Expect brief increase in latency but reduced 5xx.

jose: kvcache eviction spike seen ~6159871200, might have pushed mem use beyond threshold. Suggest tuning prefetch limiter.

matt: I've queued a canary to route non-critical small batches to dedicated-cpu pool; monitoring.

olivia: nvml log shows mem usage spike then immediate reclaim attempts, but slab fragmentation high. Patching suggestion: avoid full-model re-loads during peak.

maya: customer-impact note: ~2% of hosted generation requests in us-west2 reported 503 between 6159871180-6159871300. Logged in incident tracker.

pagerduty: PD#4021 acknowledged by olivia at 6159871240. Escalation to SRE lead in 10m if unresolved.

jose: recommending temporary scale-out of gpupool-e2 by +2 instances and lower prefetch window for kvcache.

matt: provisioned 2 extra nodes (started), ETA ~4m. Also bumped autoscale threshold to be more aggressive for this pool.

olivia: restart complete for inferd-12, services reporting healthy. Doing post-restart memory profiling.

sam: switching traffic back gradually. No new 5xx in the last 90s. Latency normalized.

maya: reminder to file post-incident notes: root cause hypothesis = kvcache-prefetch + slab fragmentation causing transient OOM. Action items: 1) adjust prefetch limit, 2) add mem headroom to pool, 3) improve alerting to include slab fragmentation metric.

olivia: closing PD (resolution: partial mitigation, followups created). I'll hand off to long-form postmortem owners. :white_check_mark:
